title: oreodaphne minarum
intro: Oreodaphne minarum, commonly known as the Himalayan Oreodaphne or Himalayan Snow Rose, is a plant species in the Lauraceae family. It is native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Oreodaphne minarum include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
